v1.query:
query GetBlockDetails {
  block(where: {height:{_eq: 327000}}){
    accepted_by {
      accepted_at # "null" if only known via historical sync
      node {
        first_connected_at
        latest_connection_began_at
        name
        protocol_version
        unconfirmed_transaction_count
        user_agent
      }
    }
    bits
    encoded_hex
    fee_satoshis
    generated_value_satoshis
    hash
    header
    height
    input_count
    input_value_satoshis
    merkle_root
    nonce
    output_count
    output_value_satoshis
    previous_block_hash
    size_bytes
    timestamp
    transaction_count
    version
  }
}
